name: Phi-3
short_description: Phi-3 is a family of small language models from Microsoft, including Phi-3-mini, Phi-3-small, Phi-3-medium and Phi-3-vision, designed for low-latency, cost-sensitive and on-device or local deployment.

evidence.quote: 5.3.5 mini, one of Microsoft's own SLMs, runs at about $0.10 per million tokens.
